prompt: How many years had the then-Prime Minister of France been in office as PM when the first Shelby GT500 was built?
answer: The first Shelby GT500 was built in **1967**, when **Georges Pompidou** was France’s prime minister. He had been in office since **14 April 1962**, so he had served for **about 4 years and 9 months—nearly five years**.
